required_consumer_behavior: Use active_start_row_index and active_end_row_index for active objective rows.
Use --include-corrupted or equivalent when evaluating boundary-cropped active segments listed in coverage_summary.boundary_cropped_active_segments.
Do not treat yaw_launch or SEC_40_YAW as outlier/stress-only data.
Do not read logged UKF, replay, or replayed state columns.

corruption_policy.deterministic_cutoff_rule: Rows after the predetermined terminal fault cutoff are excluded. Boundary-ended segments remain eligible only through their manifest active_start_row_index..active_end_row_index window for primary active tuning/evaluation.
corruption_policy.excluded_segments: Recovery-family segments are excluded from this representative corpus. Post-boundary rows and terminal corrupted tails are not part of this corpus.
corruption_policy.no_ukf_state: Do not read ukf_state_*, logged_ukf_state*, replay_state*, or replayed_state* columns.
corruption_policy.replay_note: Plain replay skips boundary-ended segments unless --include-corrupted is supplied. Tuners/evaluators using this corpus must opt into boundary-cropped active rows and then restrict the primary objective to active rows.
corruption_policy.source_of_truth: Use segment_manifest.json end_reason, end_criterion, corruption_note, active_start/end rows, and source terminal fault metadata.
